payload.artist_html: L. Ridolfi, A. E. Schrøder, A. Bahrami, M. Yazdi, A. Roa-Varón, G. Marramà, G. Carnevale
payload.credit_html: "A new fossil from the Eocene of Iran provides new insights regarding the evolution of the morphologically bizarre tube-eye fish"
payload.description_html: Parastylephorus anatoides from the Eocene deposits of Babaheydar, Iran, holotype, IUGM 100897. A, sulfur map, close-up of four rectangular lateral-line scales. B, close-up of three of the scales figured in A. C, close-up of the vertebral column of Stylephorus chordates, MCZ 138107. D, interpretative reconstruction of a lateral-line scale of the caudal region of the body of Parastylephorus anatoides. The head is to the right. Scale bars represent: 10 mm (A–C); 2 mm (D).
